title: Automatic OpenAPI & Swagger/ReDoc JSON Schema Generation Mechanics
prerequisites: RESTful API design and JSON Schema

progressiveExplaining.eli5: In other frameworks, you have to write a code file and then write a separate documentation document, which always gets outdated. In FastAPI, the computer reads your type hints and Pydantic models and automatically writes the complete interactive documentation manual (`/docs` and `/redoc`) for you on the fly.
progressiveExplaining.junior: FastAPI automatically generates an **OpenAPI (v3.1)** JSON specification from your route handlers, path parameters, type annotations, and Pydantic schemas. It serves interactive Swagger UI docs at `/docs`, ReDoc at `/redoc`, and the raw JSON schema at `/openapi.json`. You can customize endpoint metadata using `summary`, `description`, `response_description`, `tags`, and `status_code` directly in `@app.get()`.
progressiveExplaining.senior: Architecturally, schema generation happens lazily on the first request to `/openapi.json` and is cached on `app.openapi_schema`. FastAPI traverses the registered `APIRoute` list, extracting path parameters from URL regexes, query parameters from function signatures, request bodies from Pydantic `model_json_schema()`, and security schemes from `Security` dependencies. It merges them into an OpenAPI 3.1.0 compatible JSON object supporting JSON Schema standard $defs and nullability.
progressiveExplaining.underTheHood: In `fastapi.openapi.utils.get_openapi`, FastAPI extracts `route.dependant`. It calls `get_openapi_path` for each route. Pydantic models are analyzed via `pydantic.json_schema.GenerateJsonSchema`, converting Python types (`int`, `datetime`, `UUID`) into JSON Schema types (`integer`, `string(date-time)`, `string(uuid)`). Security dependencies generate entries in the `components.securitySchemes` dictionary.

rosettaStone.fastapi: Automatic `/docs` generated via Python type hints and Pydantic schemas.
rosettaStone.express: Manual swagger-jsdoc JSDoc comments or tsoa.

codeComparison.title: Manual Swagger YAML Documentation vs FastAPI Automatic Generation
codeComparison.summary: Writing manual Swagger YAML drifts from reality; FastAPI generates 100% synchronized OpenAPI specs from type hints.

legacyOrBad.label: Manual Swagger YAML (Drifts from Code)
legacyOrBad.snippet: # ❌ swagger.yaml must be updated manually on every code change

fullFile.code:
# ❌ OLD: Writing separate YAML OpenAPI documentation files.
# Changes made in code frequently drift from the documentation, leading to client bugs.
paths:
  /items/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get item
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer

modernOrGood.label: FastAPI Automatic OpenAPI Generation
modernOrGood.snippet: @app.get('/items/{id}', summary='Get item') def read(id: int): ... // ✅ NEW: Auto-generated from types

interviewGotchas.question: How can you disable the `/docs` and `/redoc` documentation endpoints in production for security?
interviewGotchas.contextIntro: Interviewers test your knowledge of production deployment hardening.
interviewGotchas.detailedAnswer:
Pass `docs_url=None`, `redoc_url=None`, and `openapi_url=None` when instantiating `FastAPI()`:
```python
app = FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None)
```
This completely disables the documentation routes and hides the OpenAPI JSON schema from public discovery in production.
interviewGotchas.trapWarning: Disabling `docs_url` but leaving `openapi_url='/openapi.json'` still exposes your full API surface and internal schema definitions.

interviewGotchas.question: How does FastAPI resolve duplicate Pydantic model names across different modules in the OpenAPI schema?
interviewGotchas.contextIntro: Checks knowledge of OpenAPI schema component collision resolution.
interviewGotchas.detailedAnswer: By default, Pydantic uses the class name (e.g. `Item`) for the `$defs` schema key. If two different modules define `class Item(BaseModel)`, a schema collision occurs. To fix this, customize the `model_config` or set a custom `operation_id` generator, or set `app.openapi_schema = None` and override the `app.openapi()` method using unique qualified model names.
interviewGotchas.trapWarning: Having two identical model names with different fields will cause one schema to overwrite the other in `/docs`.
